name: Zalo Backup
short_description: Local, offline backup + viewer for Zalo PC conversations — export, merge duplicates across accounts, snapshot→master crawl, media master, and a built-in offline viewer.
description: Local, offline backup + viewer for Zalo PC conversations. Export in 4 formats, download media with date stamps, merge duplicate self-chat exports across accounts into a deduplicated master, run a snapshot->master crawl, and browse everything in a built-in offline viewer.
